decisions.reason: This plug-in product line sits squarely in the firm's core geospatial component business and is inexpensive to keep available while demand across formats and variants continues to sort itself out.

The building data digital twin service remains strategically attractive for enterprise and public-sector integration, but because it is more delivery-intensive and market adoption is still uncertain after two years, it stays on the market as a more fragile option.
An open GIS application development framework is close to the firm's technical base and ecosystem logic, so as a flexible product line it is still worth retaining rather than abandoning.

The GIS-focused identity and access service still supports the firm's broader integration agenda, and after dropping the adjacent authentication product it makes sense to keep this more targeted option open.

This workshop extends the established consulting and training business with low commitment and low carrying cost, so it is sensible to leave it in the market while its lead-generation and cross-selling value becomes clearer.
